body.message:
Hi, we're a family of five (two adults, our 4-year-old daughter and 13-month-old twins) relocating to Dubai. We're looking for a furnished 3-bedroom apartment or villa on a monthly basis from 1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027 (4 months).

We're open on area. We're considering Dubai Marina/JBR, Palm Jumeirah, Downtown, Dubai Hills, Dubai Creek Harbour, Meydan/MBR City, Damac Hills, Arabian Ranches, JVC, and villa communities like the Springs, Meadows and Jumeirah Park. Close to a nursery is a priority.

Our budget is around US$5,500 (about AED 20,000) per month all-in.

With two babies, we'd need two cots and two high chairs, plus child-safe balconies and pool access.

Could you send what you have available with the monthly rate, what's included (DEWA/utilities cap, Wi-Fi, cleaning, Tourism Dirham fee), the deposit, and the cancellation terms?

Thank you,
Zeus Zamani
